menu_options.cloud: Log in with my Maxi-Cosi account (auto-discover)

cloud.title: Log in
cloud.description: Use your Maxi-Cosi app account. Credentials are used once to fetch your device(s) and local key; polling afterwards is fully local.

mfa.title: Verification code
mfa.description: Enter the code Maxi-Cosi just emailed you.

confirm.title: Local connection
confirm.description: Confirm the local IP for {name}. It was auto-detected if possible; reserve this IP in your router's DHCP so it doesn't change.

manual.title: Maxi-Cosi Baby Monitor
manual.description: Enter the monitor's local Tuya details. See the README for how to obtain the device ID and local key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the details and that the monitor is on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email, password and verification code.

abort.no_devices: No devices with a local key were found on this account.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the monitor. Higher values reduce load and gaps when the app is also connected (10–3600s).
